summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (new finished_time field on Task, finished property now based on finished_time, _reset and Progress.reset clear it, _capture_finished_time called at end of update() and advance() inside the lock, new TimeElapsedColumn class between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column unit test, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns and its expected output hand-derived from the mock clock tick sequence). Not verified by running: the expected string in test_columns was derived by hand and may need adjustment after running pytest. Known caveat: in update(), the existing refresh=True render still runs before the finished-time capture. Docs (docs/source/progress.rst) were not updated.
